project_use.intended_task: apple fruit instance segmentation and maturity-stage classification
project_use.why_not_production: The dataset is from an external orchard and does not establish performance for the user's property, camera, cultivar, lighting, season, or agronomic decision. It must not replace local collection and independent evaluation.
project_use.next_gate: Convert selected annotations to the project schema only after crop/task are confirmed, then evaluate on an independent local field set.
